class.name: ECSPrefabBridge
class.brief_description: Translation layer between Godot Scenes and ECS Entities.
class.description: [ECSPrefabBridge] parses [PackedScene] resources and translates their node hierarchies into optimized ECS entity bundles, facilitating easy spawning of complex objects.

method.name: spawn_from_scene
method.description: Spawns an entity from a scene file and optionally attaches it to a parent entity.
